proofs.text: Commit a new file at each of `skills/build/SKILL.md`, `agents/reviewer.md` and `.claude/agents/helper.md`, none of them scoped by any spec; run drift and verify all 3 come back NEW_BEHAVIOR and none comes back NO_IMPACT

rule_text: A changed file under `skills/`, `agents/` or `.claude/agents/` that no spec scopes is NEW_BEHAVIOR and never NO_IMPACT: those directories hold behaviour even though the files are markdown

tests.name: test_a_behaviour_directory_is_never_no_impact
